hooks.command: bash -c 'FP=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if echo "$FP" | grep -qE "\.(pbxproj|xcworkspace|xib|storyboard)$|xcodeproj/|xcworkspace/"; then echo "BLOCKED: Do not modify Xcode project files directly. Create Swift files and add them to Xcode manually." >&2; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'FP=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if echo "$FP" | grep -qE "\.entitlements$"; then echo "BLOCKED: Do not modify .entitlements files without explicit user permission." >&2; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'CMD=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "\b(git|gh)\b.*--(force-with-lease|force|no-verify|admin)\b"; then echo "BLOCKED: --force/--force-with-lease/--no-verify/--admin bypass safety checks (core rule 8). If truly necessary, stop and ask the user first." >&2; exit 2; fi'
bash -c 'FP=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if echo "$FP" | grep -qE "\.swift$"; then swiftformat --config {{COMPONENT_PREFIX}}.swiftformat "$FP" --quiet; fi'

bash -c 'FP=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if echo "$FP" | grep -qE "\.swift$"; then out=$(swiftlint lint --strict --config {{COMPONENT_PREFIX}}.swiftlint.yml --quiet "$FP" 2>&1) || { printf "%s\n" "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; fi'
